description: This file defines the WorkExperience class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for display fields related to an employee's work experience report component. It extends a base display field class and provides specific configurations such as DTO class, entity alias, and fields for report generation.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: Represents a display field for employee work experience in reports, extending ListableDisplayField and providing specific configurations such as DTO class, entity alias, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the report context for this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields associated with this display field.
